assertions.assertion: The CO-97 denial of CPT 93271 is being appealed.
CPT 93271 is a cardiac event monitoring study.
The study was ordered for this patient.
The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness.
The palpitations and lightheadedness raise concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0).
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction (Z86.73, G45.9).
The study was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of these transient cerebral ischemic events.
The study was ordered to guide anticoagulation management.
The documented findings support the medical necessity of CPT 93271 for this episode.
